access_method: Hugging Face Hub Parquet shards using dataset config 20231101.en and revision e6057dc557255a03c9c3c47ceab0eb44353b1bc5; acquire shards sequentially with resumable HTTP/Hugging Face caching
intended_purpose: Planned factual-language continuation pilot with article-level provenance.
quality_risks: encyclopedic content can still be inaccurate, disputed, biased, or outdated
article, geography, demographic, and topic imbalance
redirects, disambiguation pages, citation remnants, templates, lists, and boilerplate may remain
the provider notes 20,200,062,385 decoded bytes but does not publish VASU-tokenizer counts
required_quality_filters: accept only config 20231101.en and split train
verify main/article namespace and reject non-article namespace records
remove redirects and disambiguation pages when reliably identified
clean residual markup, citation artifacts, empty text, and boilerplate-heavy records
normalize malformed Unicode to NFC and reject undecodable records
require at least 200 normalized characters; segment records above 100000 characters at paragraph boundaries
retain article id, title, URL, source revision, shard, and attribution provenance
deduplication_requirements: hash normalized document text and remove exact duplicates
apply deterministic MinHash/LSH near-duplicate detection over normalized word 5-grams with a documented threshold
measure and remove exact and near-duplicate overlap with both existing FineWeb continuation sources
record every removal count and rule in the preparation manifest
contamination_risks: benchmark questions, answers, and source passages may be quoted in articles
facts and phrasing from the VASU fixed evaluation prompts may appear verbatim
preparation must scan normalized text and n-grams against all repository evaluation prompts before tokenization
approval_notes: Approved for bounded acquisition and preparation from the pinned official Parquet snapshot. Reuse and redistribution require article-level attribution, a license link, change notices, ShareAlike compliance for adaptations, preservation of additional source notices, and exclusion or separate review of fair-use material.
notes: The official pinned dataset card publishes 41 Parquet shards, 6,407,814 examples, 11,630,929,031 compressed bytes, and 20,200,062,385 decoded bytes. The 5,000,000,000 raw-token figure is a planning estimate, not an observed VASU-tokenizer count. The dataset card declares CC-BY-SA-3.0 and GFDL; the GFDL text is https://www.gnu.org/licenses/fdl-1.3.html. No data was downloaded by this review.
